title: Artifact Annotations Partially Substitute for Per-User Calibration: SAFE-EDA and a Normalization-Controlled Evaluation of Wrist-EDA Affect Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.01692v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Wrist electrodermal activity (EDA) differs in amplitude from one person to the next, so affect-recognition models normalize their input before classification. Studies that test such models on held-out subjects seldom report where the normalization statistics come from, yet statistics computed from the held-out subject's own recording give the model information that a device does not have when it is first worn. We asked how this choice alters the measured benefit of pretraining. A compact convolutional network, SAFE-EDA, was pretrained on expert artifact annotations from 43 subjects and compared with the same network trained from scratch on the Wearable Stress and Affect Detection (WESAD) dataset (15 subjects, leave-one-subject-out), with two normalization sources crossed with four window hops. translated_title: 伪影标注可部分替代逐用户校准：SAFE-EDA与归一化受控的腕部皮肤电活动情感识别评估
translated_abstract: 腕部皮肤电活动（EDA）的幅值因人而异，因此情感识别模型在分类前需对输入进行归一化。在留出受试者上测试此类模型的研究很少报告归一化统计量的来源，然而由留出受试者自身记录计算得到的统计量，为模型提供了设备首次佩戴时所不具备的信息。我们探究了这一选择如何改变预训练所测得的收益。研究将一个紧凑的卷积网络SAFE-EDA在来自43名受试者的专家伪影标注上进行预训练，并与在Wearable Stress and Affect Detection（WESAD）数据集（15名受试者，留一受试者交叉验证）上从零开始训练的相同网络进行比较，同时将两种归一化来源与四种窗口跳跃步长进行交叉组合。当统计量仅来自训练受试者时，预训练使宏F1提升了0.078至0.227；当统计量来自留出用户的完整……
tldr: 该研究提出紧凑卷积网络SAFE-EDA，通过在43名受试者的专家伪影标注上进行预训练，证明伪影标注预训练可部分替代逐用户校准——当归一化统计量仅来自训练受试者时，腕部EDA情感识别的宏F1可提升0.078至0.227。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SAFE-EDA, a compact convolutional network pretrained on expert artifact annotations from 43 subjects, showing that artifact-annotation pretraining partially substitutes for per-user calibration and raises wrist-EDA affect recognition macro-F1 by 0.078 to 0.227 when normalization statistics come only from training subjects.
